visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler wearing a cream-colored dinosaur-print onesie is crawling energetically across a large bed. He is laughing and playing with a woman who is lying down under white sheets. The bedroom background features a decorative headboard with blue and grey rectangular panels and animal decals on the wall. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the toddler interacting with the woman. He playfully hugs her face and attempts to bite her nose while both giggle. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting their joyful expressions. Text overlays appear describing his affectionate mode and playful antics. (3) The scene shifts to the toddler lying on the other side of the bed next to a man. The toddler immediately begins to wail loudly, kicking his legs in protest. The man lies still, seemingly unbothered, while variety-show style text captures the toddler's sudden meltdown mode upon realizing his father is there. (4) The man is seen holding a smartphone, ignoring the toddler's crying, which adds a comedic layer to the comparison. The toddler eventually stops crying and lies down alone with a look of resignation. The video concludes with the mother laughing behind the camera at the situation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the high-pitched, jubilant squealing and laughter of a toddler. This is layered over a bright, rhythmic piano-driven background track that sets a playful tone. Low-frequency rustling of bed linens and fabric can be heard as the child moves around. (2) A sudden hard cut in the visual is accompanied by a dramatic shift in the vocal track to loud, strained, and high-intensity crying from the toddler. The music continues its upbeat tempo, creating a humorous juxtaposition with the child's apparent distress. (3) Distant, muffled female laughter enters the mix, suggesting the person filming is amused by the contrast in the child's behavior. The crying intensity fluctuates, peaking when the child sees the father and then slowly tapering off into quiet whimpers. (4) As the toddler stops crying, the ambient indoor room tone becomes more prominent. The final seconds feature a burst of clear, high-valence female laughter that dominates the audio track, concluding the comedic comparison as the background music reaches its final phrase.
